proposed_title.text: A3P5 NEMESIS: A Reproducible Engineering Framework for a Four-Wheel-Steering Prototype with Robotic Sampling, Environmental Inspection and an External-Data Machine-Learning Calibration Benchmark
proposed_title.reason: Identifies the existing prototype, steering architecture, intended missions and separate external benchmark. External-data wording prevents implying that the rover sensors or autonomy have been experimentally validated.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: The sampling rack remains in its photographed side position, and the blue atmospheric enclosure remains behind the arm.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: The sampling rack remains in its photographed side position, and the blue enclosure remains behind the arm.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: The photographs establish the blue enclosure and its position, but do not independently establish an atmospheric-sensing function. The reported sensor inventory is already specified in Section 7.1.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Link gravity, acceleration and friction must be added.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: For n joints, q denotes the joint-coordinate vector and T_j the successive link transforms from base frame B to tool frame E. In the torque expression, the gravity term accounts for link weight, while the remaining dynamic term represents inertial and frictional contributions.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Defines the transform and joint symbols and reconciles the prose reference to friction with Eq. 6, which has no separate friction term. This is an interpretation of the symbolic model, not a measured dynamics claim.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: The simplified calculation holds the unladen base centre of mass fixed and adds a payload at a declared forward location. This isolates one sensitivity but omits the movement of the arm links themselves.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: The simplified calculation combines base mass m_b at position p_b with payload mass m_p at position p_p. It holds the unladen base centre of mass fixed and adds the payload at a declared forward location, isolating one sensitivity while omitting movement of the arm links themselves.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Defines the symbols used in Eq. 7 without changing the assumed mass distribution; render p_b and p_p as vectors consistently with the equation.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Force-angle and edge-moment approaches, such as Papadopoulos and Rey (1996), become necessary when external forces, inertial loads or noncoplanar contacts matter.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: Force-angle and edge-moment methods, including the stability measure of Papadopoulos and Rey (1996), provide ways to extend the assessment to loading and contact geometry beyond this simplified coplanar model.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Avoids implying that one particular family of stability methods is mandatory for every more general problem.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Figures 25–27 summarize the ultraviolet and atmospheric interfaces, the water-assessment workflow and the calculated pH-conditioning response.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: Figure 25 presents the calculated pH-conditioning response, Figure 26 the water-assessment workflow, and Figure 27 the ultraviolet, pressure and temperature interfaces.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Matches the actual figure order exactly, making the prose-to-figure mapping unambiguous.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Mechanical traction power is divided by a separate drivetrain conversion efficiency of 0.80 and added to an assumed 20 W auxiliary load. The two factors serve different roles and are not repeated corrections to the same quantity.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: Mechanical traction power is divided by a separate battery-to-ground efficiency of 0.80 and added to an assumed battery-side auxiliary demand of 20 W. The energy derating and conversion efficiency act on different quantities. With battery capacity expressed in ampere-hours, usable energy is in watt-hours; dividing by battery power in watts gives endurance in hours.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: The code uses battery-to-ground efficiency, not a motor-only factor. Defining auxiliary power on the battery side prevents omission or double application of branch-converter losses. Makes Eq. 14–15 units explicit.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Environmental patrol combines travel and observation. The rover approaches a station, reduces speed, confirms readiness, dwells as required, records the observation and resumes travel.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: The proposed environmental-patrol sequence combines travel and observation: approach a station, reduce speed, confirm readiness, dwell as required, record the observation and resume travel.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Avoids presenting the proposed mission sequence in language that can be read as an observed rover operation.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Two thousand bootstrap replicates sampled these complete observed-day blocks with replacement, keeping the same sampled indices across model families.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: Two thousand bootstrap replicates sampled calendar-day blocks with replacement, retaining every eligible observation within each selected day and using the same sampled indices across model families.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Clarifies that blocks contain all available observations for a day, not necessarily 24 complete hourly measurements. The algorithm and intervals remain unchanged.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: The chronological trace and hourly agreement plot retain the full test period rather than selecting a favourable episode.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: The plots cover the full test date range; the daily trace includes days with at least 12 eligible observations, while the hourly agreement plot and reported scores use all 1,102 eligible test observations.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: The trace omits under-covered days by design, so full test period should not be read as plotting every observation. Matches Fig. 42 and the implementation.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Validation-only permutation sensitivity, evaluated over ten repeats after selection, was largest for PT08.S2(NMHC):
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: For the validation-selected Ridge model, permutation sensitivity evaluated on validation data over ten repeats was largest for PT08.S2(NMHC):
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Explicitly names the fitted model whose feature sensitivity was computed. The implementation uses selected[winner], not every model family.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: (c) validation RMSE increase after predictor permutation, with mean and standard deviation over ten repeats.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: (c) validation-selected Ridge RMSE increase after predictor permutation on validation data, with mean and standard deviation over ten repeats.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Makes the standalone caption specify the model and partition underlying panel (c).

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: A heavier arm can increase reach or handling capacity while narrowing the support margin.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: An arm redesign that increases reach or allowable payload may also increase moving mass and narrow the support margin.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Mass alone does not cause improved reach or payload capacity; the revision states the actual design tradeoff conditionally.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Deterministic sensitivity analysis of assumed energy and stability inputs. One-at-a-time ±20% changes isolate model dependence and are not confidence intervals. The centre-of-mass sweep demonstrates why a photo-based stability claim is underdetermined.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: Deterministic sensitivity analysis of assumed energy and stability inputs. Panel (a) changes one energy-model input at a time by ±20%; panel (b) varies unloaded centre-of-mass height from 0.35 to 0.85 m for three payload scenarios. These sweeps show model dependence and are not confidence intervals.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: The ±20% perturbation applies only to the energy panel. The stability panel uses a wider independent height sweep; the new caption accurately distinguishes them.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Measuring torque on a known slope tests the rolling-resistance assumptions.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: Controlled wheel-torque measurements on documented grades and surfaces can assess the combined force-demand model; isolating rolling resistance also requires control of acceleration, loading and drivetrain losses.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: A single torque result on a known slope does not uniquely identify rolling resistance. The revision states the identification requirements without inventing measurements.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: A3P5 NEMESIS was developed here as a traceable design study connecting a photographed rover to an industrially detailed reconstruction, subsystem diagrams, mission concepts and reproducible analyses.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: This study connects the photographed A3P5 NEMESIS prototype to an industrially detailed geometric reconstruction, subsystem architectures, proposed mission sequences and reproducible analyses.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Separates the pre-existing physical prototype from the design-study work reported in this manuscript.

prose_and_caption_replacements.old: Together, the results define a sequence of identification, calibration, fault testing and integrated trials. Subsequent work should quantify integrated performance through the identified calibration, fault-response and field experiments.
prose_and_caption_replacements.new: Together, the results define a sequence of physical identification, sensor calibration, fault testing and integrated trials through which the proposed inspection functions can be evaluated.
prose_and_caption_replacements.rationale: Removes two adjacent sentences that repeat the same future-work sequence while retaining its substance.

graph_label_recommendations.reason: The plot computes demanded output torque; it does not identify a verified continuous motor torque rating. Caption already states required torque.

graph_label_recommendations.old: Fail-safe clearance depends on measured braking
graph_label_recommendations.new: Stopping clearance depends on braking and delay
graph_label_recommendations.reason: Fail-safe implies a stronger protective property than the assumed stopping model establishes. No plotted values change.

graph_label_recommendations.old: pH measurement requires explicit analog gain
graph_label_recommendations.new: pH conditioning and ideal ADC resolution
graph_label_recommendations.reason: Makes the graph title descriptive; pH measurement requires a suitable high-impedance interface but not necessarily gain greater than unity.
